questions.q: Where is Betaflight's main PID loop?
questions.explain: taskMainPidLoop → subTaskPidController → subTaskMotorUpdate: the PID controller and the mixer are subtasks of the loop.

questions.q: What is the D term computed from in Betaflight?
questions.explain: So there is no derivative kick when the stick moves.

questions.q: Where in ArduCopter is the task table with rates and time budgets?
questions.explain: FAST_TASK and SCHED_TASK(func, hz, max_us, prio).

options: Mixes the axes into the motors
Runs the EKF and writes the log
questions.explain: It mixes roll/pitch/yaw/throttle through the motor matrix with priorities: roll/pitch first, then as much yaw as fits (MOT_YAW_HEADROOM is the guaranteed minimum), and throttle into the remaining range.

questions.q: Where does the ArduPilot parameter wiki come from?
options: From the @Param blocks in the code
Written by hand by the developer team
questions.explain: The description, range and @Values live in the code.

In the Configurator through the CLI

questions.q: Why link to a commit rather than to master in your notes?
options: Over time a master link points to different code
